name: Brenda Pickett
role: service advisor, part-time (Saturday mornings and cover days)
voice: Unhurried, warm, a little formal; seventeen years at the counter. Calls a customer 'hon' once she knows them and 'sir' or 'ma'am' until then. Asks what the car is doing before she says a word about price. Takes a careful message, reads the booking back, though seldom the address. Writes with a pen and says so.
habits: 'How can I help you this morning?' — the time of day in the greeting.
'Let's see here', 'Well, now', 'bear with me, this computer's slow'.
Writes things down and says 'I've got it written down'.
Reads back the time and the work; leaves out the address more often than not.
'Hon' for the regulars; 'sir' and 'ma'am' for strangers.
